course_name_original: UE Mathématiques approfondies pour l'ingénieur - MAT306 -
syllabus_topics: Vector spaces over R: structure of a vector space and examples; vector subspaces; family of vectors and linear combination; free and generating families; basis and dimension
Vector calculus (linear applications; scalar product and orthogonality; norm; orthonormal basis and projection)
Matrix calculus (matrices and vector space; matrix product; transpose; particular matrices - square, triangular, diagonal, symmetric)
Matrices and linear applications (matrix associated with a linear application)
Matrices and linear systems (matrix writing of a linear system; determinant; nature of solutions of a linear system; invertibility - and inverse matrix; Gauss pivot method)
Generalized least squares method (normal equation system)
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
